utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — book club. I missed a couple updates, so what’s the book and meeting time again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll remind everyone of the book club plan and the title, then we can sort out the meeting time together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks — I probably missed the latest update too. What book are we doing, and did the time change?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll resend the book club details and keep next Thursday at my place on the calendar. Bring those cozy mystery or family-theme options, and we’ll pick something fun for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara — I’ll note next Thursday at your place and check the book club details so I can share the latest with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Opal — thank you. I’ll resend the details, and we can all compare cozy mystery and family-theme picks next Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — book club’s still on at my place this week. I’m confirming the day and time now, and I’ll send the details so everyone’s aligned.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — send the time when you have it and I’ll do my best to make it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’ll send the time as soon as I confirm it, and I really appreciate you being flexible.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll drop off the book club details later, and then we can sort out the plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for the details and vote when you send them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — I’ll bring the details by later, and then we can pick a plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the snacks and tea covered, and I’ll grab a few extra napkins too. If you want, I can send over the book and meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, please do — can you send the book title and meeting time? Just want to make sure I’ve got everything right.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll send the book title and meeting time over in a quick note. We should be all set for book club once I add those napkins.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if I hear any gossip about the shortlist. Fingers crossed they pick something light and fun this time!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess — that’d be great. I’m hoping for something lively too, but I’m ready for whatever gets people talking.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You know, that’s the spirit — something lively would be fun if it gets everyone talking. I’ll ask around and pass along any whispers I hear!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — what time is the book club meeting? I need to make sure it doesn’t clash with school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll check the details and see what time Mara set for next Thursday, then I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Sam — I appreciate it. Just let me know the time when you hear back from Mara, and I’ll check it against pickup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me — first Thursday each month is easy to remember, and I’m happy to start with “The Midnight Library.” Let’s keep the next few books picked ahead of time so we stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli — that’s helpful. Could you send the exact time and place once it’s set so I can plan my ride?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Absolutely — I’ll send the exact time and place as soon as we set it, so your ride’s easy to plan.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club — I’m still a bit fuzzy, but I can check with Mara and resend the latest details once I have them. Want me to do that?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, please—if you can resend them, that would help. I’m still thinking next Thursday evening, and I’d like to keep it short and easy for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll check with Mara and resend the latest details, including next Thursday evening and the short, easy format. I may be a little fuzzy, but I’ll get it over to you as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m hoping they pick something easy and fun this week. Have you heard what Nell’s leaning toward?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I’m leaning toward something easy and fun too. Do you know what the next book is yet?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet — I’m still waiting to hear. If you find out before I do, let me know?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: 7 works for me — I’ll send the time and place ahead so everyone can plan.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, 7 works for me too — thanks, Quinn. Send the place when you can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did we settle on a title yet, or is that still being decided at the meeting?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re still deciding at the meeting, Mina — I’ll make sure everyone gets the updated details and the Thursday cafe spot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Rosa — please send the updated details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late again — just send me the book list and I’ll vote right away. I can also bring snacks if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Dane — Mara’s sending the list, and I’d love your vote plus any snack ideas. Let’s lock in the next date and book before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll vote as soon as Mara sends the list, and I can bring chips or cookies for snacks. Just let me know the date and I’ll be there if I’m not running late again.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, are we still doing book club at your place this week? And can you confirm the day and time for me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still checking on that, so I can’t confirm yet. I’ll find out the day, time, and spot, and then let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — please confirm the day, time, and your place as soon as you know. And let me know who’s bringing the snacks too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you decide on a meeting time, or should I wait for the details?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still locking that in, but I’ll send the day and time as soon as I have it. Thanks for hanging tight — I want to make sure everyone gets the same details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, thanks — I’ll wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Leo — I’ll resend the book club details and keep next Thursday at my place on the calendar. If you’ve got a cozy mystery or family-theme pick, bring it along and we’ll choose something fun for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll bring a cozy mystery and send it over. See you next Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks, Leo — I’ll look out for it and keep next Thursday set. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still a bit fuzzy on the title, sorry—do you remember what we’re reading next?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don’t have the exact title yet, but I can check on it and get back to you. If you want, I can also bring a simple snack unless someone else already has that covered.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be lovely, thanks — and a simple snack sounds great if no one else has it covered.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thursday still works for me — I’ll send a couple lighter picks soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — send the short options when you can, and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Will do — I’ll send over a couple short, easy reads later today.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I might have missed the email—could you remind me of the title? Then I’ll make sure I’m on the right page.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — it’s the neighborhood book club on Maple Street, and we’re picking the next read tonight. If you want, I can also give you the shortlist so you can catch up fast.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — could you send me the shortlist? I’d like to check the options before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks—if 7 pm still works, I’ll be there after pickup. And we’re reading The Midnight Library, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, 7 pm still works, and The Midnight Library is the one. I’ll bring the extra napkins, so we should be all set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks—7 works for me after pickup. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if I hear any gossip about the shortlist. Hopefully they pick something light and fun this time!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — light and fun sounds perfect. I’ll keep everyone posted as soon as the shortlist is set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, that’ll help everyone stay in the loop. I’ll listen for any whispers too and pass along anything I hear!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll drop off the book club details later, then we can sort out the plan.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I’ll check with Mara and get the latest details if anything changed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Oren — I’ll bring the details by later, and then we can sort out the book club plan.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the time, place, and next reading list ahead of time so everyone can plan. We’re starting with "The Midnight Library," and I’ll keep the rest locked in early too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, that helps a lot — I’m glad to know the first pick and have the details ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll get the invite and full details out soon so you can plan ahead. Looking forward to kicking off with "The Midnight Library"!
